Definition: to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate
BiblicalUsage: lâshan means to wag the tongue, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Proverbs 30:10, "Accuse not a servant unto his master"; and in Psalms 101:5, "Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe slander is a small sin with a large ruin — a whispered accusation can curse a servant and cut off a neighbour.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
